iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>DSMHub</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600&family=Press+Start+2P&family=VT323&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#0d0d0f;--panel:#17181c;--panel2:#202228;--line:#2c2e35;--text:#f1f2f4;--dim:#9a9ca6;--accent:#87cf3e;--wall:radial-gradient(ellipse at 55% 45%,#2a2b31 0%,#141518 55%,#08080a 100%);box-sizing:border-box}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}*{scrollbar-width:none!important;-ms-overflow-style:none!important}*::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important;width:0!important;height:0!important}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:13px/1.35 Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;user-select:none}
#desk{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--wall);background-size:cover}
#logo{position:absolute;left:50%;top:46%;width:240px;height:240px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-18deg);border-radius:50%;border:16px solid #d8d9dd;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000a,inset 0 0 20px #0008;opacity:.9;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}
#logo b{font-size:96px;color:#d8d9dd;letter-spacing:-6px}
#icons{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,84px);grid-auto-rows:92px;grid-auto-flow:row;align-content:start;gap:0}
.ic{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 2px;border-radius:6px;cursor:default;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000}
.ic:hover{background:#ffffff14}.ic.sel{background:#87cf3e30;outline:1px solid #87cf3e66}
.g{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0007}
.win{position:absolute;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px #000b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;min-width:260px;min-height:160px}
.win.max{inset:0 0 0 0!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;border-radius:0}
.win.min{display:none}
.tb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 6px 0 12px;height:36px;background:var(--panel2);cursor:grab;flex:none}
.tb span{flex:1;font-weight:500;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tb button{width:28px;height:24px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:var(--dim);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
.tb button:hover{background:#ffffff1c;color:var(--text)}.tb .x:hover{background:#e5484d;color:#fff}
.body{flex:1;overflow:auto;position:relative;min-height:0}
.rs{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:16px;height:16px;cursor:nwse-resize}
#bar{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);height:60px;background:#1c1d22b3;backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.3);border:1px solid #ffffff1c;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:0 8px;z-index:9999}
.tbtn{height:46px;min-width:46px;padding:0 8px;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:none;color:var(--text);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;position:relative;transition:transform .12s ease}
.tbtn:hover{background:none;transform:translateY(-6px)}
.tbtn.on::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-7px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text)}
.tbtn.act{background:none}
.tbtn .g{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:17px;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:none}
#bar #start .g,#bar #tasks .g{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px}
#dock-sep{width:1px;align-self:stretch;margin:10px 4px;background:#ffffff26;flex:none}
#tasks{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
#dock-pinned{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
#dock-date{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 12px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--text);min-width:52px}
#dd-day{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
#dd-date{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
#traytop{position:fixed;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--dim);background:#1c1d22b3;backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.3);border:1px solid #ffffff1c;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px;z-index:9999}
#clk{text-align:right;line-height:1.15;color:var(--text);font-size:12.5px}#clk small{display:block;color:var(--dim);font-size:10.5px}
#sd{width:16px;height:22px;border:1.5px solid var(--dim);border-radius:3px;background:none;cursor:pointer}
#sd:hover{border-color:var(--text)}
#menu{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0b0c0ecc;backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.1);display:none;z-index:9998;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) calc(48px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)}
#menu.open{display:flex}
#menu-left{width:min(420px,46vw);height:100%;padding:28px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-right:1px solid #ffffff14}
#menu input{padding:12px 14px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;user-select:text;flex:none}
#menu input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.menu-h{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
#list{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(80px,1fr));gap:4px;align-content:start}
.apptile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 4px 26px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;font:inherit}
.apptile:hover{background:#ffffff14}
.apptile-actions{position:absolute;left:4px;right:4px;bottom:4px;display:flex;gap:3px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s}
.apptile:hover .apptile-actions,.apptile:focus-within .apptile-actions{opacity:1}
.pin{flex:1;font-size:9px;padding:3px 2px;border-radius:5px;background:#ffffff1c;color:var(--dim);text-align:center}
.pin:hover{background:#ffffff33;color:var(--text)}
.pin.on{background:var(--accent);color:#10150a}
.wp{height:100%;overflow:auto;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.wp-h{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-top:8px}
.wp-note{color:var(--dim);font-size:11.5px;margin:0}
.wp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px}
.wp-card{aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);background-size:cover;background-position:center;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:6px;font-size:11px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.wp-card span{position:relative;z-index:1;background:#0009;color:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 5px;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.wp-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 35%,#0008)}
.wp-add{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr auto;gap:6px}
.wp-add input{min-width:0;width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);font:inherit;font-size:12px}
.wp-status{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);min-height:14px;margin:0}
.wp-card.on{border-color:var(--accent)}
.wp-reset{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:6px}
.apptile span{font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%}
.apptile .g{width:40px;height:40px}
.pad-dim{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--dim);padding:16px 4px}
#menu-acct{flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff14}
.acct-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:4px 2px}
.acct-av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:#10150a;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 12px Poppins,sans-serif;flex:none}
#menu-acct .tbtn{width:100%;height:40px;justify-content:center;background:var(--panel2);border-radius:8px}
#menu-right{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:0 0 10vh}
#menu-date{text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000a}
#md-day{font:32px 'Press Start 2P',monospace;letter-spacing:2px;color:#fff}
#md-date{font:22px VT323,monospace;letter-spacing:2px;color:#e8e9ec;margin-top:10px}
#md-time{font:17px VT323,monospace;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:4px}
@media (max-width:720px){#menu{flex-direction:column}#menu-left{width:100%;height:auto;flex:1;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff14}#menu-right{padding-bottom:4vh}#md-day{font-size:20px}#md-date{font-size:17px}}
.pad{padding:14px}
textarea.np{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;resize:none;background:#111215;color:var(--text);font:13px/1.5 ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;padding:12px;outline:none;user-select:text}
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;padding:10px;height:100%;grid-auto-rows:1fr}
.calc .scr{grid-column:1/-1;background:#0e0f12;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:right;font-size:26px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;min-height:54px}
.calc button{border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);font:500 16px Poppins,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.calc button:hover{background:#2b2e36}.calc .op{background:#2c3a1c;color:var(--accent)}.calc .eq{background:var(--accent);color:#10150a}
.urlbar{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px;background:var(--panel2)}
.urlbar input{flex:1;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;user-select:text}
.urlbar button,.btn{padding:7px 14px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent);color:#10150a;font:500 13px Poppins,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
iframe{width:100%;height:calc(100% - 50px);border:0;background:#fff}
.fl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(92px,1fr));gap:6px;padding:12px}
.fl .ic{padding:10px 2px}
.sw{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.sw div{width:84px;height:54px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}
.sw div:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}

#lock{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;background:#0c0a12;transition:opacity .5s,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.3,1)}
#lock::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-40px;filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.1);background-image:var(--wallimg),var(--garden);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
#lock::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#0006}
#lock>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
#lock.gone{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-24px);pointer-events:none}
#lt{font:46px 'Press Start 2P',monospace;color:#fff;letter-spacing:4px;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #0008,0 0 24px #0009}
#ld{font:30px VT323,monospace;color:#f3eef4;letter-spacing:3px;margin-top:22px;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000a}
#lc{font:22px VT323,monospace;color:#fff;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:38px;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000a}
#lh{position:absolute;bottom:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));font:20px VT323,monospace;color:#ffffffa0;letter-spacing:2px;animation:bl 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:.35}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#lh{animation:none}#lock{transition:opacity .2s}}
@media (max-width:560px){#lt{font-size:26px}#ld{font-size:24px}}
#lockbtn{margin:0 10px 10px;height:40px;justify-content:center;background:var(--panel2)}
:root{--wallimg:none;--garden:radial-gradient(ellipse 22% 30% at 12% 62%,#6aa646aa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 20% 26% at 30% 70%,#e88fb0aa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 26% 30% at 62% 78%,#4f8a3eaa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 18% 24% at 82% 64%,#ee9ab8aa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 22% at 50% 14%,#8a3a5caa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 34% 28% at 50% 42%,#b9a3b8aa,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 14% 90% at 4% 40%,#0b0b1a,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 14% 90% at 96% 40%,#0b0b1a,transparent)}
#desk{overflow:hidden}
#desk::before,#desk::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-40px;display:none;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
#desk::before{filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.1);background-image:var(--wallimg),var(--garden);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
#desk::after{inset:0;background:#0006}
#desk.garden::before,#desk.garden::after{display:block}
#icons{z-index:1}
.g{box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0007,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff48}
.g svg{width:56%;height:56%}
.g.sm{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:none}
.ti{width:18px;height:18px}
img.g,.tbtn img.g{border-radius:23%;display:block;object-fit:contain;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0006}
.tbtn img.g,#tasks img.g{box-shadow:none}
.set h4{margin:16px 0 8px;font-weight:600}.set h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.set .row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.set input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;user-select:text}
.set input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn.alt{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text)}
[data-theme=light]{--bg:#eef0f4;--panel:#f7f8fa;--panel2:#e8ebf0;--line:#d5d9e0;--text:#1c1e24;--dim:#5d6270}
[data-theme=light] .tbtn:hover,[data-theme=light] .tb button:hover{background:#00000012}
[data-theme=light] .tbtn.act{background:#0000001a}
[data-theme=light] textarea.np,[data-theme=light] #menu input,[data-theme=light] .urlbar input,[data-theme=light] .set input{background:#fff}
[data-theme=light] .calc .scr{background:#e4e7ec}
[data-theme=light] .calc button:hover{background:#d9dde4}
[data-theme=light] .calc .op{background:#e0f0cd;color:#3b7d12}
.gm{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.gt{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px 8px 0;background:var(--panel2);overflow-x:auto;flex:none}
.gt .sp{flex:1}
.gtab{border:0;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;background:none;color:var(--dim);font:500 12.5px Poppins,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.gtab:hover{background:#ffffff10;color:var(--text)}.gtab.on{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text)}
.gc{opacity:.55}.gc:hover{opacity:1}
.gx{gap:8px;padding:8px;background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:none}
.gv{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;background:var(--bg)}
.gv iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#fff}
.ge{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--dim);padding:20px;text-align:center}
.gl{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:20px;text-align:center}
.gl h3{font-size:18px}.gl p{color:var(--dim)}.gl .row{display:flex;gap:8px}.gl .er{color:#f87171;min-height:1.3em}
.gl input,.gx input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;user-select:text}
.gl input:focus,.gx input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
[data-theme=light] .gtab:hover{background:#0000000d}
[data-theme=light] .gl input,[data-theme=light] .gx input{background:#fff}
.gg{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:auto;padding:0 14px 14px;background:var(--bg)}
.gs{position:sticky;top:0;padding:12px 0;background:var(--bg);z-index:2}
.gs input{width:100%;max-width:380px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;user-select:text}
.gs input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(104px,1fr));gap:12px}
.gn{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--dim);padding:24px 0;text-align:center}
.tile{aspect-ratio:1;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);color:var(--dim);cursor:pointer;position:relative;display:block;transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.tile:hover,.tile:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0008;outline:none}
.tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.tile>span:not(.rm){position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:22px 6px 7px;font:500 11px Poppins,sans-serif;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#000d);text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tile:hover>span:not(.rm),.tile:focus-visible>span:not(.rm){opacity:1}
.tile.ph{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tile.ph>span:not(.rm){position:static;padding:0 8px;background:none;opacity:1;color:var(--dim);max-width:100%}
.tile.bad{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.rm{position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#000a;color:#fff;font-size:10px;display:none;place-items:center}
.tile:hover .rm{display:grid}
.win:fullscreen{border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
.win:fullscreen .tb,.win:fullscreen .rs{display:none}
.win:-webkit-full-screen{border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
.win:-webkit-full-screen .tb,.win:-webkit-full-screen .rs{display:none}

/* DSMHub Discord-style community chat */
.dch{height:100%;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr) 190px;background:#313338;color:#f2f3f5;font:13px/1.45 Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
.dch button,.dch input,.dch textarea{font:inherit}
.dch-channels{background:#2b2d31;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.dch-head{height:49px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #202124;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.dch-channel-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 10px 5px;color:#949ba4;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em}
.dch-channel-list{padding:0 7px 8px;overflow:auto;min-height:0}
.dch-category{margin-top:9px}
.dch-category:first-child{margin-top:0}
.dch-category-head{height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 3px;color:#949ba4;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.dch-category-add,.dch-add-category{width:23px;height:23px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:#b5bac1;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.dch-category-add:hover,.dch-add-category:hover{background:#404249;color:#fff}
.dch-admin-note{padding:10px 9px;color:#f0c674;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}
.dch-channel{width:100%;height:34px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:#b5bac1;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer}
.dch-channel:hover{background:#35373c;color:#dbdee1}
.dch-channel.active{background:#404249;color:#fff}
.dch-hash{font-size:18px;color:#949ba4}
.dch-server-info{margin-top:auto;padding:11px 12px;background:#232428;color:#b5bac1;font-size:11px}
.dch-server-info strong{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:12px}
.dch-main{min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#313338}
.dch-top{height:49px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #25262a;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #0003}
.dch-top .dch-hash{font-size:23px}
.dch-top strong{font-size:14px;color:#fff}
.dch-topic{color:#b5bac1;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.dch-top-spacer{flex:1}
.dch-connection{font-size:11px;color:#949ba4}
.dch-user{max-width:142px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#dbdee1;font-size:11px}
.dch-small-btn{height:29px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:#404249;color:#e3e5e8;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px}
.dch-small-btn:hover{background:#4d5058}
.dch-messages{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:18px 18px 12px;user-select:text}
.dch-welcome{padding:8px 0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #41434a;margin-bottom:16px}
.dch-welcome .dch-hash{display:grid;place-items:center;width:55px;height:55px;border-radius:50%;background:#41434a;color:#fff;font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px}
.dch-welcome h2{font-size:22px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px}
.dch-welcome p{color:#b5bac1;font-size:12px}
.dch-message{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:7px 4px;border-radius:4px}
.dch-message:hover{background:#2e3035}
.dch-avatar{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#5865f2;color:white;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.dch-msg-content{min-width:0;flex:1}
.dch-msg-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;margin-bottom:2px}
.dch-msg-head strong{font-size:12px;color:#f2f3f5}
.dch-msg-head time{font-size:10px;color:#949ba4}
.dch-msg-body{color:#dbdee1;font-size:12px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.dch-message-tools{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:4px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s}
.dch-message:hover .dch-message-tools,.dch-message:focus-within .dch-message-tools{opacity:1}
.dch-message-delete,.dch-manage-member{border:0;border-radius:4px;background:#404249;color:#dbdee1;padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer}
.dch-message-delete:hover,.dch-manage-member:hover{background:#b33b42;color:#fff}
.dch-attachments{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;margin-top:8px}
.dch-attachment{width:min(100%,360px);padding:8px;border:1px solid #41434a;border-radius:7px;background:#292b30;color:#dbdee1;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px}
.dch-attachment:hover{border-color:#5865f2}
.dch-attachment-preview{display:block;max-width:min(100%,360px);max-height:240px;object-fit:contain;margin-top:7px;border-radius:7px;cursor:zoom-in}
.dch-member{min-width:0}
.dch-role-badge{flex:none;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 5px;background:#414b87;color:#dfe2ff;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
.dch-role-badge.owner{background:#725533;color:#ffe2a6}
.dch-member-tools{margin-left:auto}
.dch-file-picker{width:30px;height:32px;flex:none;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#b5bac1;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}
.dch-file-picker:hover{background:#45474f;color:#fff}
.dch-file-queue{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;padding:0 3px 5px}
.dch-file-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;max-width:100%;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid #45474f;border-radius:6px;background:#292b30;color:#c9cbd0;font-size:10px}
.dch-file-chip span{max-width:240px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.dch-file-chip button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#b5bac1;cursor:pointer}
.dch-file-error{color:#ff8b8b;font-size:10px;padding:2px 3px}
.dch-empty{color:#949ba4;text-align:center;padding:24px;font-size:12px}
.dch-composer-wrap{padding:8px 16px 15px;flex:none}
.dch-compose{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:9px;padding:9px 10px;background:#383a40;border-radius:8px}
.dch-compose textarea{flex:1;min-width:0;max-height:130px;resize:vertical;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#f2f3f5;user-select:text}
.dch-compose textarea::placeholder{color:#949ba4}
.dch-send{width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#5865f2;color:#fff;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.dch-send:hover{background:#4752c4}
.dch-compose-help{padding:5px 3px 0;color:#949ba4;font-size:10px}
.dch-members{background:#2b2d31;padding:16px 11px;overflow:auto}
.dch-members h3{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#949ba4;margin:1px 5px 10px}
.dch-member{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 5px;color:#dbdee1;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden}
.dch-member .dch-avatar{width:27px;height:27px;font-size:10px}
.dch-member-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.dch-gate{height:100%;min-height:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:18px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#3b3d4b,#1e1f22 70%);color:#f2f3f5;overflow:auto}
.dch-card{width:min(100%,460px);padding:25px;background:#2b2d31;border:1px solid #41434a;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px #0006}
.dch-card h2{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:5px;color:#fff}
.dch-card>p{color:#b5bac1;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:17px}
.dch-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.dch-brand-mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:#5865f2;display:grid;place-items:center}
.dch-field{display:block;color:#c9cbd0;font-size:11px;margin:11px 0 5px}
.dch-input{width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #45474f;border-radius:6px;background:#1e1f22;color:#fff;outline:none;user-select:text}
.dch-input:focus{border-color:#5865f2}
.dch-primary{height:38px;padding:0 13px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#5865f2;color:#fff;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.dch-primary:hover{background:#4752c4}
.dch-setup-submit{width:100%;margin-top:15px}
.dch-note{margin-top:12px;color:#949ba4;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
.dch-error{min-height:16px;margin-top:8px;color:#ff8b8b;font-size:11px}
.dch-auth{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:250px}
.dch-auth-note{color:#b5bac1;font-size:11px;text-align:center;margin:12px 0}
#menu .updater{margin:0 10px 10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel2)}
#menu .updater-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:2px}
#menu .updater-status{min-height:15px;color:var(--dim);font-size:10px;margin:3px 0 7px}
#menu .updater-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#menu .updater button,#menu .updater a{font:inherit;font-size:10px}
#menu .updater a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}
#menu .updater a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:930px){.dch{grid-template-columns:210px minmax(0,1fr)}.dch-members{display:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){.dch{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.dch-channels{display:none}.dch-messages{padding:12px 9px}.dch-composer-wrap{padding:7px 9px 10px}.dch-top{padding:0 9px}.dch-topic{display:none}}

.sg{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:12px;gap:10px;overflow:auto}.sg-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;background:var(--panel2);border-radius:10px;padding:10px}.sg-title,.sg-body{width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;resize:vertical}.sg-title:focus,.sg-body:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}.sg-post{align-self:flex-end}.sg-msg{color:#f87171;min-height:1.2em;margin:0}.sg-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.sg-card{background:var(--panel2);border-radius:10px;padding:10px}.sg-card-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}.sg-by{color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.sg-card p{margin:4px 0 8px;white-space:pre-wrap}.sg-card-f{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.sg-vote{border:1px solid var(--line);background:none;color:var(--text);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}.sg-vote.on{background:#87cf3e30;border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}.sg-del{border:0;background:none;color:#f87171;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}
.dm{height:100%;display:flex}
.dm-side{width:220px;flex:none;border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;overflow:auto}
.dm-search{padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none}
.dm-search:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.dm-h{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-top:6px}
.dm-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:4px 2px;font-size:12px}
.dm-friend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text);padding:6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;text-align:left}
.dm-friend:hover,.dm-friend.on{background:var(--panel2)}
.dm-av{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:#10150a;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 11px Poppins,sans-serif;flex:none}
.dm-main{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.dm-empty{margin:auto;color:var(--dim)}
.dm-thread{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dm-thread-h{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600}
.dm-msgs{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:10px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.dm-msg{max-width:70%;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel2);align-self:flex-start;font-size:13px}
.dm-msg.me{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--accent);color:#10150a}
.dm-send{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.dm-input{flex:1;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none}
.dm-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.st{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:12px;gap:10px}
.st-strip{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;flex:none;padding-bottom:4px}
.st-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;flex:none;width:64px}
.st-ring{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;padding:2px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#fb7185);display:block}
.st-ring img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:2px solid var(--panel)}
.st-item span:last-child{font-size:10px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%}
.st-view{flex:1;min-height:0;border-radius:10px;background:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.st-view img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;cursor:pointer}
.st-add{flex:none}
.st-cam{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:10px;align-items:center}
.st-cam video,.st-prev canvas,.st-prev img{max-width:100%;max-height:60%;border-radius:8px}
.st-text{width:80%;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font:inherit;outline:none;text-align:center}
.st-cam-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
</style>
</head>

function builtin(n){const[a,b,p]=IC[n],d=theme==='dark';return 'data:image/svg+xml,'+encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${d?a:mix(a,.82)}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${d?b:mix(b,.72)}"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="63" height="63" rx="14.5" fill="url(#g)"/><g transform="translate(16 16) scale(1.333)" fill="none" stroke="${d?'#fff':b}" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${p}</g></svg>`)}

const saveLinks=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('dsmhub-links',JSON.stringify(links))}catch(e){}};
// ---- layout: which apps are pinned to the dock / home screen, synced per account ----
let layout={taskbar:['chat','custom-spotify'],home:['files','games','chat'],wallpaper:null};
try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dsmhub-layout')||'null');if(saved)layout=Object.assign(layout,saved)}catch(e){}
let layoutSaveTimer=null;
function saveLayout(){
 try{localStorage.setItem('dsmhub-layout',JSON.stringify(layout))}catch(e){}
 clearTimeout(layoutSaveTimer);
 layoutSaveTimer=setTimeout(async()=>{
  const acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();const uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
  if(!acc||!uid)return;
  try{await acc.db.from('user_layouts').upsert({user_id:uid,data:layout,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()})}catch(e){console.warn('[layout] cloud save failed',e)}
 },1200)
}
async function loadCloudLayout(){
 const acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();const uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
 if(!acc||!uid)return;
 try{
  const{data,error}=await acc.db.from('user_layouts').select('data').eq('user_id',uid).maybeSingle();
  if(!error&&data&&data.data){layout=Object.assign({taskbar:[],home:[],wallpaper:null},data.data);drawIcons();renderDockPinned();applyWallpaper(layout.wallpaper)}
 }catch(e){console.warn('[layout] cloud load failed',e)}
}
function togglePin(kind,id){
 const arr=layout[kind];const i=arr.indexOf(id);
 if(i>-1)arr.splice(i,1);else arr.push(id);
 saveLayout();drawIcons();renderDockPinned()
}
function renderDockPinned(){
 const el=$('#dock-pinned');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML='';
 layout.taskbar.forEach(id=>{
  const a=apps.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!a)return;
  const open=wins.find(o=>o.a.id===id);
  const btn=mk(glyph(a),'button','tbtn'+(open?' on':''));btn.title=a.n;
  btn.onclick=()=>{if(open)focus(open);else openApp(id)};
  el.append(btn)
 })
}
function dockDateTick(){const d=new Date();const dd=$('#dd-day'),de=$('#dd-date');if(dd)dd.textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'short'});if(de)de.textContent=d.getDate()}
setInterval(dockDateTick,60000);dockDateTick();

// ---- wallpapers: online presets, custom URLs, and local uploads ----
// Direct image/video URLs work here. YouTube links are displayed as muted background embeds.
const WALLPAPER_PRESETS=[
];
const WALLPAPER_CUSTOM_KEY='dsmhub-custom-wallpapers-v1';
function readCustomWallpapers(){try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(WALLPAPER_CUSTOM_KEY)||'[]');return Array.isArray(x)?x.filter(w=>w&&w.n&&w.src&&['image','video'].includes(w.type)):[]}catch(e){return[]}}
function youtubeEmbed(src){try{const u=new URL(src);let id='';if(u.hostname.includes('youtu.be'))id=u.pathname.slice(1);else if(u.hostname.includes('youtube.com')){if(u.pathname==='/watch')id=u.searchParams.get('v')||'';else if(u.pathname.startsWith('/embed/'))id=u.pathname.split('/')[2]||'';else if(u.pathname.startsWith('/shorts/'))id=u.pathname.split('/')[2]||''}if(!id)return null;return 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'?autoplay=1&mute=1&controls=0&loop=1&playlist='+encodeURIComponent(id)+'&playsinline=1&rel=0'}catch(e){return null}}
function wallpaperTypeFromUrl(src){if(youtubeEmbed(src))return 'video';return /\.(mp4|webm|ogv|mov)(\?|#|$)/i.test(src)?'video':'image'}
function applyWallpaper(w){
 const desk=$('#desk');if(!desk)return;
 let layer=$('#desk-wallpaper-layer');if(layer)layer.remove();
 desk.style.backgroundImage='';desk.style.backgroundSize='cover';desk.style.backgroundPosition='center';
 if(!w||!w.src){desk.style.backgroundImage='';return}
 if(w.type==='video'){
  const yt=youtubeEmbed(w.src);
  if(yt){layer=document.createElement('iframe');layer.src=yt;layer.title='Wallpaper video';layer.allow='autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture';layer.referrerPolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin';layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');layer.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:100vw;height:56.25vw;min-width:177.78vh;min-height:100vh;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0';}
  else{layer=document.createElement('video');layer.src=w.src;layer.autoplay=true;layer.loop=true;layer.muted=true;layer.playsInline=true;layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');layer.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:0;pointer-events:none';layer.addEventListener('error',()=>{layer.style.display='none'});}
  layer.id='desk-wallpaper-layer';desk.prepend(layer);if(layer.tagName==='VIDEO')layer.play().catch(()=>{});
 }else{desk.style.backgroundImage=`url("${String(w.src).replace(/["\\]/g,'\\$&')}")`;}
}
// Auto-finds wallpapers you've dropped in a 'wallpapers' folder in the repo —
// no manual listing needed. Images show as-is; mp4/webm/mov files loop as live wallpapers.
let ghWallpapersCache=null;
async function loadGithubWallpapers(){
 if(ghWallpapersCache)return ghWallpapersCache;
 try{
  const r=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/DSMOnVR/dsmhub/contents/wallpapers');
  if(!r.ok)return ghWallpapersCache=[];
  const files=await r.json();
  ghWallpapersCache=(Array.isArray(files)?files:[]).filter(f=>f.type==='file'&&/\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|mp4|webm|mov)$/i.test(f.name)).map(f=>({
   n:f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),
   type:/\.(mp4|webm|mov)$/i.test(f.name)?'video':'image',
   src:'wallpapers/'+encodeURIComponent(f.name)
  }))
 }catch(e){ghWallpapersCache=[]}
 return ghWallpapersCache
}
function wallpapersApp(b){
 b.innerHTML='<div class="wp"><div class="wp-h">Upload your own</div><input type="file" accept="image/*,video/*" class="wp-file"><p class="wp-note">Uploads work on this browser session only. To keep a wallpaper available after refresh or for other visitors, add an image/video URL below.</p><div class="wp-h">Add online wallpaper</div><form class="wp-add"><input class="wp-name" placeholder="Wallpaper name" aria-label="Wallpaper name"><input class="wp-url" type="url" placeholder="Image, MP4, or YouTube URL" aria-label="Wallpaper URL" required><button class="btn" type="submit">Add</button></form><p class="wp-status" role="status"></p><p class="wp-note">Wallpapers also load automatically from a <code>wallpapers</code> folder in the repo — drop an image or an mp4/webm/mov in there and it shows up here (an mp4/webm/mov plays as a looping live wallpaper).</p><div class="wp-h">Wallpapers</div><div class="wp-grid"></div><button class="btn alt wp-reset">Reset to default</button></div>';
 const grid=$('.wp-grid',b),status=$('.wp-status',b);let ghWallpapers=[];
 function allPresets(){return [...WALLPAPER_PRESETS,...ghWallpapers,...readCustomWallpapers()]}
 function card(w,isCurrent){
  const el=mk(`<span>${esc(w.n)}</span>`,'button','wp-card'+(isCurrent?' on':''));
  if(w.type==='image')el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${String(w.src).replace(/["\\]/g,'\\$&')}")`;
  else {const yt=youtubeEmbed(w.src);if(yt){el.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(135deg,#29233b,#111827)';}else el.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(135deg,#1f2937,#374151)';}
  el.title=w.n+(w.type==='video'?' (video)':' (image)');
  el.onclick=()=>{layout.wallpaper={type:w.type,src:w.src};saveLayout();applyWallpaper(layout.wallpaper);renderGrid()};
  return el
 }
 function renderGrid(){grid.innerHTML='';const cur=layout.wallpaper;allPresets().forEach(p=>grid.append(card(p,cur&&cur.src===p.src)));if(!allPresets().length)grid.append(mk('No wallpapers available yet.','p','pad-dim'))}
 $('.wp-file',b).onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;if(!f.type.startsWith('image/')&&!f.type.startsWith('video/')){status.textContent='Choose an image or video file.';return}const url=URL.createObjectURL(f);const w={n:f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),type:f.type.startsWith('video/')?'video':'image',src:url};layout.wallpaper=w;saveLayout();applyWallpaper(w);status.textContent='Wallpaper applied for this browser session.';renderGrid()};
 $('.wp-add',b).onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const name=$('.wp-name',b).value.trim(),src=$('.wp-url',b).value.trim();if(!src)return;let parsed;try{parsed=new URL(src)}catch(err){status.textContent='Enter a valid URL beginning with https://';return}if(!['http:','https:'].includes(parsed.protocol)){status.textContent='Use an http:// or https:// URL.';return}const w={n:name||'Custom wallpaper',type:wallpaperTypeFromUrl(src),src};const custom=readCustomWallpapers();if(!custom.some(x=>x.src===src))custom.push(w);try{localStorage.setItem(WALLPAPER_CUSTOM_KEY,JSON.stringify(custom));}catch(err){status.textContent='Could not save this preset in browser storage. Try a shorter list.';return}layout.wallpaper={type:w.type,src:w.src};saveLayout();applyWallpaper(layout.wallpaper);$('.wp-url',b).value='';$('.wp-name',b).value='';status.textContent='Wallpaper added and applied. Custom URL presets are saved in this browser.';renderGrid()};
 $('.wp-reset',b).onclick=()=>{layout.wallpaper=null;saveLayout();applyWallpaper(null);status.textContent='Wallpaper reset.';renderGrid()};
 renderGrid();
 (async()=>{ghWallpapers=await loadGithubWallpapers();renderGrid()})();
}
// ---- DMs + friends (reuses dsmhub_profiles for usernames) ----
function dmsApp(b){
 b.innerHTML='<div class="dm"><div class="dm-side"><input class="dm-search" placeholder="Search by username"><div class="dm-results"></div><div class="dm-h">Requests</div><div class="dm-requests"></div><div class="dm-h">Friends</div><div class="dm-friends"></div></div><div class="dm-main"><div class="dm-empty">Pick a friend to message.</div></div></div>';
 const search=$('.dm-search',b),results=$('.dm-results',b),reqEl=$('.dm-requests',b),friendsEl=$('.dm-friends',b),main=$('.dm-main',b);
 let acc=null,uid=null,myName='you',friends=[],incoming=[],outgoing=[],active=null,pollTimer=null;
 async function refreshFriends(){
  const rows=(await acc.db.from('friends').select('id,requester_id,addressee_id,status').or(`requester_id.eq.${uid},addressee_id.eq.${uid}`)).data||[];
  friends=rows.filter(r=>r.status==='accepted').map(r=>r.requester_id===uid?r.addressee_id:r.requester_id);
  incoming=rows.filter(r=>r.status==='pending'&&r.addressee_id===uid);
  outgoing=rows.filter(r=>r.status==='pending'&&r.requester_id===uid);
  const ids=[...new Set([...friends,...incoming.map(r=>r.requester_id),...outgoing.map(r=>r.addressee_id)])];
  let names={};
  if(ids.length){const p=(await acc.db.from('dsmhub_profiles').select('user_id,username').in('user_id',ids)).data||[];p.forEach(x=>names[x.user_id]=x.username)}
  reqEl.innerHTML='';
  incoming.forEach(r=>{const row=mk(`<span>${esc(names[r.requester_id]||r.requester_id)}</span>`,'div','dm-row');
   const ok=mk('Accept','button','btn');ok.onclick=async()=>{await acc.db.from('friends').update({status:'accepted'}).eq('id',r.id);refreshFriends()};
   const no=mk('Decline','button','btn alt');no.onclick=async()=>{await acc.db.from('friends').delete().eq('id',r.id);refreshFriends()};
   row.append(ok,no);reqEl.append(row)});
  outgoing.forEach(r=>{const row=mk(`<span>${esc(names[r.addressee_id]||r.addressee_id)} (pending)</span>`,'div','dm-row');
   const cancel=mk('Cancel','button','btn alt');cancel.onclick=async()=>{await acc.db.from('friends').delete().eq('id',r.id);refreshFriends()};
   row.append(cancel);reqEl.append(row)});
  if(!incoming.length&&!outgoing.length)reqEl.append(mk('Nothing pending.','p','pad-dim'));
  friendsEl.innerHTML='';
  if(!friends.length)friendsEl.append(mk('No friends yet \u2014 search above to add some.','p','pad-dim'));
  friends.forEach(fid=>{const row=mk(`<span class="g dm-av">${esc((names[fid]||'?')[0].toUpperCase())}</span><span>${esc(names[fid]||fid)}</span>`,'button','dm-friend'+(active===fid?' on':''));
   row.onclick=()=>openThread(fid,names[fid]||fid);friendsEl.append(row)})
 }
 let searchTimer=null;
 search.oninput=()=>{clearTimeout(searchTimer);const q=search.value.trim();results.innerHTML='';if(!q)return;
  searchTimer=setTimeout(async()=>{
   const rows=(await acc.db.from('dsmhub_profiles').select('user_id,username').ilike('username','%'+q+'%').limit(8)).data||[];
   results.innerHTML='';
   rows.filter(r=>r.user_id!==uid).forEach(r=>{
    const known=friends.includes(r.user_id)||outgoing.some(o=>o.addressee_id===r.user_id)||incoming.some(i=>i.requester_id===r.user_id);
    const row=mk(`<span>${esc(r.username)}</span>`,'div','dm-row');
    const add=mk(known?'Pending/Friend':'Add','button','btn'+(known?' alt':''));add.disabled=known;
    add.onclick=async()=>{await acc.db.from('friends').insert({requester_id:uid,addressee_id:r.user_id});search.value='';results.innerHTML='';refreshFriends()};
    row.append(add);results.append(row)})
  },250)
 };
 function openThread(fid,name){
  active=fid;refreshFriends();
  main.innerHTML=`<div class="dm-thread"><div class="dm-thread-h">${esc(name)}</div><div class="dm-msgs"></div><div class="dm-send"><input class="dm-input" placeholder="Message ${esc(name)}"><button class="btn dm-go">Send</button></div></div>`;
  const msgsEl=$('.dm-msgs',main),input=$('.dm-input',main);
  async function loadMsgs(){
   const rows=(await acc.db.from('dm_messages').select('sender_id,body,created_at').or(`and(sender_id.eq.${uid},recipient_id.eq.${fid}),and(sender_id.eq.${fid},recipient_id.eq.${uid})`).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(200)).data||[];
   msgsEl.innerHTML='';rows.forEach(m=>{const el=mk(esc(m.body),'div','dm-msg'+(m.sender_id===uid?' me':''));msgsEl.append(el)});
   msgsEl.scrollTop=msgsEl.scrollHeight
  }
  async function send(){const v=input.value.trim();if(!v)return;input.value='';await acc.db.from('dm_messages').insert({sender_id:uid,recipient_id:fid,body:v});loadMsgs()}
  $('.dm-go',main).onclick=send;input.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')send()};
  loadMsgs();
  clearInterval(pollTimer);pollTimer=setInterval(loadMsgs,4000)
 }
 (async()=>{
  acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
  if(!acc||!uid){b.innerHTML='<div class="pad-dim">Sign in through Chat to use DMs.</div>';return}
  myName=(window.Clerk&&window.Clerk.user&&window.Clerk.user.username)||'you';
  await refreshFriends()
 })()
}

// ---- stories: friends-only, 24h, camera capture with a text overlay ----
function storiesApp(b){
 b.innerHTML='<div class="st"><div class="st-strip"></div><div class="st-view"></div><button class="btn st-add">+ Add to your story</button></div>';
 const strip=$('.st-strip',b),view=$('.st-view',b);
 let acc=null,uid=null,myName='you',stream=null;
 async function urlFor(path){const r=await acc.db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').createSignedUrl(path,21600);return r.error?null:r.data.signedUrl}
 async function refresh(){
  strip.innerHTML='Loading\u2026';
  const rows=(await acc.db.from('stories').select('id,user_id,username,path,created_at').order('created_at',{ascending:false})).data||[];
  const latest={};rows.forEach(r=>{if(!latest[r.user_id])latest[r.user_id]=r});
  strip.innerHTML='';
  const list=Object.values(latest);
  if(!list.length){strip.append(mk('No stories right now. Be the first.','p','pad-dim'));view.innerHTML='';return}
  list.forEach(async r=>{
   const url=await urlFor(r.path);if(!url)return;
   const ring=mk(`<span class="st-ring"><img src="${url}" alt=""></span><span>${esc(r.user_id===uid?'You':r.username)}</span>`,'button','st-item');
   ring.onclick=()=>{view.innerHTML=`<img src="${url}" alt="">`;view.onclick=()=>view.innerHTML=''};
   strip.append(ring)
  })
 }
 async function startCapture(){
  view.innerHTML='<div class="st-cam"><video autoplay playsinline muted></video><input class="st-text" placeholder="Add text\u2026" maxlength="60"><div class="st-cam-actions"><button class="btn st-shot">Capture</button><button class="btn alt st-cancel">Cancel</button></div></div>';
  const video=$('video',view);
  try{stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:true});video.srcObject=stream}
  catch(e){view.innerHTML='<p class="pad-dim">Could not access your camera. Check your browser\u2019s camera permission for this site.</p>';return}
  $('.st-cancel',view).onclick=stopCapture;
  $('.st-shot',view).onclick=()=>{
   const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=video.videoWidth||720;c.height=video.videoHeight||1280;
   const ctx=c.getContext('2d');ctx.drawImage(video,0,0,c.width,c.height);
   const text=$('.st-text',view).value.trim();
   if(text){ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(c.width/14)}px Poppins,sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.lineWidth=Math.round(c.width/160);ctx.strokeStyle='#000';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    const x=c.width/2,y=c.height-c.height*0.08;ctx.strokeText(text,x,y);ctx.fillText(text,x,y)}
   stopStream();
   view.innerHTML='<div class="st-cam"><div class="st-prev"></div><div class="st-cam-actions"><button class="btn st-post">Post to your story</button><button class="btn alt st-retake">Retake</button></div></div>';
   $('.st-prev',view).append(c);
   $('.st-retake',view).onclick=startCapture;
   $('.st-post',view).onclick=()=>postStory(c)
  }
 }
 function stopStream(){if(stream){stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());stream=null}}
 function stopCapture(){stopStream();view.innerHTML=''}
 async function postStory(canvas){
  const blob=await new Promise(res=>canvas.toBlob(res,'image/jpeg',0.85));
  const path=`${uid}/stories/${Date.now()}.jpg`;
  const up=await acc.db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').upload(path,blob,{contentType:'image/jpeg'});
  if(up.error){view.innerHTML=`<p class="pad-dim">Could not post your story: ${esc(up.error.message||'upload failed')}</p>`;return}
  const ins=await acc.db.from('stories').insert({user_id:uid,username:myName,path});
  if(ins.error){await acc.db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').remove([path]).catch(()=>{});view.innerHTML=`<p class="pad-dim">Could not post your story: ${esc(ins.error.message||'save failed')}</p>`;return}
  view.innerHTML='';await refresh()
 }
 $('.st-add',b).onclick=startCapture;
 (async()=>{
  acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
  if(!acc||!uid){b.innerHTML='<div class="pad-dim">Sign in through Chat to see and post stories.</div>';return}
  myName=(window.Clerk&&window.Clerk.user&&window.Clerk.user.username)||'you';
  await refresh()
 })()
}



const esc=t=>String(t).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c]));
const tile=l=>'data:image/svg+xml,'+encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><rect width="64" height="64" rx="15" fill="#4b5563"/><text x="32" y="43" font-size="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif">${esc((l||'?').toUpperCase())}</text></svg>`);
const iconSrc=name=>name==='chat'?builtin('chat'):/^(?:data:|https?:|blob:)/i.test(name)?name:ICON_BASE+theme+'/'+name+'.svg';
function glyph(a,sm){return `<img class="g${sm?' sm':''}" data-ic="${a.icon}" data-l="${esc(a.n[0])}" alt="" src="${iconSrc(a.icon)}">`}
function linkGlyph(x){return `<img class="g" data-l="${esc(x.n[0])}" alt="" src="${x.i?esc(x.i):tile(x.n[0])}">`}
function setIcons(){document.querySelectorAll('img[data-ic]').forEach(i=>{delete i.dataset.fb;delete i.dataset.tf;i.src=iconSrc(i.dataset.ic)})}
function setTheme(t){theme=t;document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;try{localStorage.setItem('dsmhub-theme',t)}catch(e){}setIcons()}
document.documentElement.dataset.theme=theme;setIcons();
// desktop icons + start menu
const icons=$('#icons');
function drawIcons(){icons.innerHTML='';
 const add=(html,name,open)=>{const d=mk(html+`<span>${name}</span>`,'div','ic');
  d.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();document.querySelectorAll('.ic.sel').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('sel'));d.classList.add('sel')};
  d.ondblclick=open;icons.append(d)};
 apps.filter(a=>layout.home.includes(a.id)).forEach(a=>add(glyph(a),a.n,()=>openApp(a.id)));
 links.forEach(x=>add(linkGlyph(x),esc(x.n),()=>window.open(x.u,'_blank','noopener')))}
drawIcons();renderDockPinned();applyWallpaper(layout.wallpaper);loadCloudLayout();
$('#desk').onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.ic.sel').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('sel'));menu(false)};
function drawList(f=''){const l=$('#list');l.innerHTML='';apps.filter(a=>a.n.toLowerCase().includes(f.toLowerCase())).forEach(a=>{
  const b=mk(glyph(a)+`<span>${esc(a.n)}</span>`,'button','apptile');
  b.onclick=()=>{openApp(a.id);menu(false)};
  const pins=mk(`<span class="pin${layout.taskbar.includes(a.id)?' on':''}" data-k="taskbar">${layout.taskbar.includes(a.id)?'\u2212 Dock':'+ Dock'}</span><span class="pin${layout.home.includes(a.id)?' on':''}" data-k="home">${layout.home.includes(a.id)?'\u2212 Home':'+ Home'}</span>`,'div','apptile-actions');
  pins.querySelectorAll('.pin').forEach(p=>p.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();togglePin(p.dataset.k,a.id);drawList(f)});
  b.append(pins);l.append(b)});
 if(!l.children.length)l.append(mk('No apps match that search.','div','pad-dim'))}
function menuTick(){const d=new Date();$('#md-day').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'long'});$('#md-date').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});$('#md-time').textContent=d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}
setInterval(menuTick,1000);menuTick();
async function drawAcct(){const el=$('#menu-acct');const uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
 if(uid){const name=(window.Clerk&&window.Clerk.user&&(window.Clerk.user.username||window.Clerk.user.firstName))||'Signed in';
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="acct-row"><span class="acct-av">${esc(name[0]||'?')}</span><span>${esc(name)}</span></div><button class="tbtn" id="lockbtn">Lock screen</button>`}
 else{el.innerHTML='<button class="tbtn" id="acct-signin">Sign in</button><button class="tbtn" id="lockbtn">Lock screen</button>'}
 const sb=$('#lockbtn',el);if(sb)sb.onclick=relock;
 const si=$('#acct-signin',el);if(si)si.onclick=()=>{menu(false);openApp('chat')}}
function menu(v){const m=$('#menu');m.classList.toggle('open',v);$('#start').classList.toggle('act',v);if(v){$('#q').value='';drawList();drawAcct();$('#q').focus()}}
$('#start').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();menu(!$('#menu').classList.contains('open'))};
$('#q').oninput=e=>drawList(e.target.value);
$('#q').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){const b=$('#list .tbtn');if(b)b.click()}if(e.key==='Escape')menu(false)};

// windows
function openApp(id,custom){const a=custom||apps.find(x=>x.id===id);
 const w=mk(null,'div','win');w.style.cssText=`width:${a.w}px;height:${a.h}px;left:${90+(n%8)*28}px;top:${50+(n%8)*28}px;z-index:${++z}`;n++;
 const tb=mk(`${glyph(a,1)}<span>${a.n}</span>${a.fs?'<button class="fs" title="Fullscreen" aria-label="Fullscreen"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 9V4h5M20 9V4h-5M4 15v5h5M20 15v5h-5"/></svg></button>':''}<button class="m" title="Minimize">–</button><button class="mx" title="Maximize">▢</button><button class="x" title="Close">✕</button>`,'div','tb');
 const body=mk(null,'div','body');w.append(tb,body,mk(null,'div','rs'));$('#desk').append(w);
 const btn=mk(glyph(a),'button','tbtn on');btn.title=a.n;$('#tasks').append(btn);
 const o={w,btn,a};wins.push(o);a.r(body,o);focus(o);renderDockPinned();
 const clamp=()=>{const r=$('#desk').getBoundingClientRect();w.style.left=Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(w.style.left),-w.offsetWidth+80),r.width-60)+'px';w.style.top=Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(w.style.top),0),r.height-36)+'px'};
 tb.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.target.closest('button')||w.classList.contains('max'))return;focus(o);const sx=e.clientX-w.offsetLeft,sy=e.clientY-w.offsetTop;tb.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);tb.style.cursor='grabbing';
  tb.onpointermove=ev=>{w.style.left=(ev.clientX-sx)+'px';w.style.top=(ev.clientY-sy)+'px'};
  tb.onpointerup=()=>{tb.onpointermove=tb.onpointerup=null;tb.style.cursor='';clamp()}};
 const rs=$('.rs',w);rs.onpointerdown=e=>{e.stopPropagation();focus(o);const sw=w.offsetWidth,sh=w.offsetHeight,sx=e.clientX,sy=e.clientY;rs.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  rs.onpointermove=ev=>{w.style.width=Math.max(260,sw+ev.clientX-sx)+'px';w.style.height=Math.max(160,sh+ev.clientY-sy)+'px'};rs.onpointerup=()=>rs.onpointermove=rs.onpointerup=null};
 w.onpointerdown=()=>focus(o);
 $('.m',w).onclick=()=>minim(o,true);
 const fb=$('.fs',w);if(fb)fb.onclick=()=>{const cf=document.fullscreenElement||document.webkitFullscreenElement,rq=w.requestFullscreen||w.webkitRequestFullscreen;if(cf===w)(document.exitFullscreen||document.webkitExitFullscreen).call(document);else if(rq)rq.call(w);else w.classList.toggle('max')};$('.mx',w).onclick=()=>w.classList.toggle('max');tb.ondblclick=e=>{if(!e.target.closest('button'))w.classList.toggle('max')};
 $('.x',w).onclick=()=>{if(o.onclose)try{o.onclose()}catch(e){}w.remove();btn.remove();wins.splice(wins.indexOf(o),1);renderDockPinned()};
 btn.onclick=()=>{if(w.classList.contains('min')||sel!==o)focus(o);else minim(o,true)}}
function focus(o){o.w.classList.remove('min');o.w.style.zIndex=++z;sel=o;wins.forEach(x=>x.btn.classList.toggle('act',x===o))}
function minim(o,v){o.w.classList.toggle('min',v);o.btn.classList.remove('act');if(sel===o)sel=null}
$('#sd').onclick=()=>{const all=wins.every(o=>o.w.classList.contains('min'));wins.forEach(o=>all?o.w.classList.remove('min'):minim(o,true));if(all&&wins.length)focus(wins[wins.length-1])};

// The updater finds the newest index.svg commit and opens its pinned jsDelivr URL.
(function(){
 const button=$('#check-updates'),status=$('#update-status'),link=$('#open-update');if(!button||!status||!link)return;
 button.onclick=async()=>{
  button.disabled=true;status.textContent='Checking GitHub…';link.hidden=true;
  try{
   const response=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/DSMOnVR/dsmhub/commits?path=index.svg&per_page=1',{headers:{Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'},cache:'no-store'});
   if(!response.ok)throw new Error('GitHub returned '+response.status);
   const commits=await response.json(),latest=commits&&commits[0]&&commits[0].sha;if(!latest)throw new Error('No SVG commit found.');
   let currentUrl=document.referrer||location.href;try{currentUrl=top.location.href||currentUrl}catch(e){}
   const pinned=currentUrl.match(/dsmhub@([a-f0-9]{40})\/index\.svg/i);
   status.textContent=pinned&&pinned[1]===latest?'You are already on the latest version ('+latest.slice(0,7)+').':'Latest version: '+latest.slice(0,7)+(pinned?' · update available':' · ready to open');
   link.href='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DSMOnVR/dsmhub@'+latest+'/index.svg';link.hidden=false
  }catch(e){status.textContent='Could not check GitHub. Try again in a moment.'}
  finally{button.disabled=false}
 }
})();

 const i=$('input',b),go=()=>{let u=i.value.trim();if(!u)return;if(!/^https?:\/\//.test(u))u='https://'+u;i.value=u;const m=$('#msg',b);if(m)m.remove();let fr=$('iframe',b);if(!fr){fr=document.createElement('iframe');b.append(fr)}fr.src=u};
 $('button',b).onclick=go;i.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')go()}}
function calcApp(b){const s=mk('0','div','scr'),g=mk(null,'div','calc');g.append(s);let ex='';
 '7 8 9 / 4 5 6 * 1 2 3 - 0 . C +'.split(' ').concat('=').forEach(k=>{const x=mk(k==='*'?'×':k==='/'?'÷':k,'button',k==='='?'eq':'+-*/'.includes(k)?'op':'');
  x.onclick=()=>{if(k==='C')ex='';else if(k==='='){try{ex=String(Function('"use strict";return ('+(ex||'0')+')')())}catch(e){ex=''}}else ex+=k;s.textContent=ex||'0'};g.append(x)});b.append(g)}
function setApp(b){
 b.innerHTML=`<div class="pad set"><h4>Theme</h4><div class="row"><button class="btn" data-t="dark">Dark</button><button class="btn" data-t="light">Light</button></div>
 <h4>Wallpaper</h4><div class="sw"></div>

 <div class="row"><input id="si" placeholder="Icon URL, SVG or PNG (optional)"><button class="btn" id="sa">Add</button></div><div id="sl"></div></div>`;
 const paint=()=>b.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('alt',x.dataset.t!==theme));
 b.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{setTheme(x.dataset.t);paint()});paint();

 Object.entries(wallpapers).forEach(([k,v])=>{const d=mk(null,'div');d.style.background=v==='garden'?'linear-gradient(135deg,#6aa646,#e88fb0 50%,#4f8a3e)':v;d.title=k;d.onclick=()=>{const dk=$('#desk');dk.classList.toggle('garden',v==='garden');dk.style.background=v==='garden'?'':v;$('#logo').style.display=k==='Graphite'?'':'none'};sw.append(d)});
 const list=()=>{const l=$('#sl',b);l.innerHTML='';links.forEach((x,i)=>{const r=mk(`<span>${esc(x.n)}</span>`,'div','row');const d=mk('Remove','button','btn alt');d.onclick=()=>{links.splice(i,1);saveLinks();drawIcons();list()};r.append(d);l.append(r)})};
 $('#sa',b).onclick=()=>{const n=$('#sn',b).value.trim();let u=$('#su',b).value.trim();const ic=$('#si',b).value.trim();if(!n||!u)return;if(!/^https?:\/\//.test(u))u='https://'+u;links.push({n,u,i:ic});saveLinks();drawIcons();list();['#sn','#su','#si'].forEach(q=>$(q,b).value='')};
 list()}

// ---- suggestions board (what should we add to DSMHub) ----
function suggestApp(b){
 b.innerHTML='<div class="sg"><div class="sg-form"><input class="sg-title" placeholder="Title" maxlength="80"><textarea class="sg-body" placeholder="What should DSMHub add?" rows="3" maxlength="600"></textarea><button class="btn sg-post">Post suggestion</button><p class="sg-msg"></p></div><div class="sg-list">Loading…</div></div>';
 const titleEl=$('.sg-title',b),bodyEl=$('.sg-body',b),postBtn=$('.sg-post',b),msg=$('.sg-msg',b),list=$('.sg-list',b);
 let acc=null,uid=null,myVotes=new Set();
 function card(row){
  const el=mk(null,'div','sg-card');
  const mine=uid&&row.user_id===uid;
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="sg-card-h"><strong>${esc(row.title)}</strong><span class="sg-by">by ${esc(row.username||'someone')}</span></div><p>${esc(row.body)}</p><div class="sg-card-f"><button class="sg-vote${myVotes.has(row.id)?' on':''}">\u25b2 <span>${row.votes||0}</span></button>${mine?'<button class="sg-del">Delete</button>':''}</div>`;
  const vb=$('.sg-vote',el);
  vb.onclick=async()=>{
   if(!uid){msg.textContent='Sign in through Chat first.';return}
   const have=myVotes.has(row.id);
   vb.disabled=true;
   try{
    if(have){await acc.db.from('suggestion_votes').delete().eq('suggestion_id',row.id).eq('user_id',uid);myVotes.delete(row.id);row.votes=(row.votes||1)-1}
    else{await acc.db.from('suggestion_votes').insert({suggestion_id:row.id,user_id:uid});myVotes.add(row.id);row.votes=(row.votes||0)+1}
    vb.classList.toggle('on',myVotes.has(row.id));vb.querySelector('span').textContent=row.votes
   }catch(e){msg.textContent='Could not update your vote.'}
   vb.disabled=false
  };
  const db2=$('.sg-del',el);if(db2)db2.onclick=async()=>{if(!confirm('Delete this suggestion?'))return;try{await acc.db.from('suggestions').delete().eq('id',row.id);el.remove()}catch(e){msg.textContent='Could not delete.'}};
  return el
 }
 async function refresh(){
  list.innerHTML='Loading…';
  if(!acc){list.innerHTML='<p class="sg-msg">Sign in through Chat to see and post suggestions.</p>';return}
  try{
   const{data,error}=await acc.db.from('suggestions').select('id,user_id,username,title,body,votes').order('votes',{ascending:false}).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(200);
   if(error)throw error;
   myVotes=new Set();
   if(uid){const mv=await acc.db.from('suggestion_votes').select('suggestion_id').eq('user_id',uid);if(!mv.error)myVotes=new Set((mv.data||[]).map(x=>x.suggestion_id))}
   list.innerHTML='';
   if(!data||!data.length){list.append(mk('No suggestions yet. Be the first.','p','sg-msg'));return}
   data.forEach(row=>list.append(card(row)))
  }catch(e){list.innerHTML='<p class="sg-msg">Could not load suggestions.</p>'}
 }
 postBtn.onclick=async()=>{
  const title=titleEl.value.trim(),body=bodyEl.value.trim();
  if(!title||!body){msg.textContent='Add a title and a description.';return}
  if(!acc||!uid){msg.textContent='Sign in through Chat first.';return}
  postBtn.disabled=true;msg.textContent='Posting\u2026';
  try{
   const username=(window.Clerk&&window.Clerk.user&&window.Clerk.user.username)||'someone';
   const{error}=await acc.db.from('suggestions').insert({user_id:uid,username,title,body});
   if(error)throw error;
   titleEl.value='';bodyEl.value='';msg.textContent='';await refresh()
  }catch(e){msg.textContent='Could not post your suggestion.'}
  postBtn.disabled=false
 };
 (async()=>{acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();uid=dsmCurrentUserId();await refresh()})()
}

// ---- DSMHub community chat, authenticated with Clerk and stored in Supabase ----
const DSMHUB_CHAT_DEFAULT_URL='https://vtqfeqwbuvfepjpoavrc.supabase.co';
const DSMHUB_CHAT_CONFIG={clerkKey:'pk_test_YmV0dGVyLXBvbGVjYXQtMzAzNi5jbGVyay5hY2NvdW50cy5kZXYk',supabaseUrl:'https://vtqfeqwbuvfepjpoavrc.supabase.co',supabaseKey:'sb_publishable_vuYnS7kzgPkibt9w97AIvA_6WWtNc-e'};
function chatReadConfig(){try{return {...DSMHUB_CHAT_CONFIG,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dsmhub-chat-connection')||'{}')}}catch(e){return {...DSMHUB_CHAT_CONFIG}}}
function chatSaveConfig(c){try{localStorage.setItem('dsmhub-chat-connection',JSON.stringify(c))}catch(e){}}
function chatLoadScript(name,url,publishableKey){
 if(!window.__dsmhubChatScripts)window.__dsmhubChatScripts={};
 if(window.__dsmhubChatScripts[name])return window.__dsmhubChatScripts[name];
 window.__dsmhubChatScripts[name]=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const s=document.createElement('script');s.async=true;s.crossOrigin='anonymous';s.src=url;
  if(publishableKey)s.dataset.clerkPublishableKey=publishableKey;
  s.onload=()=>resolve();s.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Could not load '+name+' from its CDN.'));
  document.head.append(s)
 });
 return window.__dsmhubChatScripts[name]
}
// ---- shared DSMHub account (same Clerk + Supabase project as chat) ----
// Used by anything that needs to know who is signed in, without requiring
// the Chat window to be open. Lazily loads Clerk + Supabase the same way
// chatApp() does, and reuses the same public keys from DSMHUB_CHAT_CONFIG.
let dsmAccountPromise=null;
function dsmEnsureAccount(){
 if(dsmAccountPromise)return dsmAccountPromise;
 dsmAccountPromise=(async()=>{
  const config=chatReadConfig();
  if(!config.clerkKey||!config.supabaseKey||!config.supabaseUrl)return null;
  try{
   const domain=atob(config.clerkKey.split('_')[2]).replace(/\$$/,'');
   if(!/^[a-z0-9.-]+$/i.test(domain))return null;
   if(!window.supabase||!window.supabase.createClient)await chatLoadScript('supabase','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js');
   if(!window.Clerk){
    await chatLoadScript('clerk-ui','https://'+domain+'/npm/@clerk/ui@1/dist/ui.browser.js');
    await chatLoadScript('clerk-sdk','https://'+domain+'/npm/@clerk/clerk-js@6/dist/clerk.browser.js',config.clerkKey)
   }
   if(!window.Clerk.loaded)await window.Clerk.load({ui:{ClerkUI:window.__internal_ClerkUICtor}});
   const clerk=window.Clerk;
   const db=window.supabase.createClient(config.supabaseUrl,config.supabaseKey,{auth:{persistSession:false,autoRefreshToken:false,detectSessionInUrl:false},accessToken:async()=>clerk&&clerk.session?await clerk.session.getToken():null});
   return {clerk,db}
  }catch(e){console.warn('[account] could not connect',e);return null}
 })();
 return dsmAccountPromise
}
function dsmCurrentUserId(){try{return window.Clerk&&window.Clerk.user?window.Clerk.user.id:null}catch(e){return null}}

// ---- game save sync (self-hosted games only; see chat message for why
// library games loaded from other sites can't be synced the same way) ----
async function gsLoad(gameId){
 const acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();const uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
 if(!acc||!uid)return null;
 try{
  const{data,error}=await acc.db.from('game_saves').select('data').eq('user_id',uid).eq('game_id',gameId).maybeSingle();
  if(error){console.warn('[save-sync] load failed',error);return null}
  return data?data.data:null
 }catch(e){console.warn('[save-sync] load failed',e);return null}
}
async function gsSave(gameId,kv){
 if(!kv||!Object.keys(kv).length)return;
 const acc=await dsmEnsureAccount();const uid=dsmCurrentUserId();
 if(!acc||!uid)return;
 try{
  const{error}=await acc.db.from('game_saves').upsert({user_id:uid,game_id:gameId,data:kv,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  if(error)console.warn('[save-sync] save failed',error)
 }catch(e){console.warn('[save-sync] save failed',e)}
}
function gsReadStorage(fr){const out={};try{const ls=fr.contentWindow.localStorage;for(let i=0;i<ls.length;i++){const k=ls.key(i);out[k]=ls.getItem(k)}}catch(e){}return out}
function gsInject(html,kv){if(!kv||!Object.keys(kv).length)return html;const boot='<script>(function(){var d='+JSON.stringify(kv)+';for(var k in d){try{localStorage.setItem(k,d[k])}catch(e){}}})();</scr'+'ipt>';return /<head[^>]*>/i.test(html)?html.replace(/<head[^>]*>/i,m=>m+boot):boot+html}
async function attachSaveSync(fr,gameId,html){
 const kv=await gsLoad(gameId);
 fr.srcdoc=gsInject(html,kv);
 let timer=null;const flush=()=>gsSave(gameId,gsReadStorage(fr));
 fr.addEventListener('load',()=>{timer=setInterval(flush,30000)});
 return()=>{if(timer)clearInterval(timer);flush()}
}

function chatApp(b){
 let config=chatReadConfig(),clerk=null,db=null,activeChannel='general',subscription=null,renderedUserId='',profileName='',busy=false,authListener=null,enteringUserId='',channelRequest=0,channelSequence=0,currentRole='member',roleMap={},categories=[],pendingFiles=[];
 const defaultCategories=[{id:'text',name:'Text Channels',position:0}];
 const defaultChannels=[{id:'general',name:'general',topic:'The place for anything DSMHub.',category_id:'text',position:0},{id:'games',name:'games',topic:'Talk about games and what you are playing.',category_id:'text',position:1},{id:'music',name:'music',topic:'Share what you are listening to.',category_id:'text',position:2},{id:'help',name:'help',topic:'Ask the community for help.',category_id:'text',position:3}];
 let channels=defaultChannels.map(x=>({...x}));
 const showSetup=(problem='')=>{
  b.innerHTML='<section class="dch-gate"><div class="dch-card"><div class="dch-brand"><span class="dch-brand-mark">D</span><span>DSMHub Community</span></div><h2>Connect your chat</h2><p>Enter the public keys for the Clerk and Supabase projects already set up for DSMHub.</p><label class="dch-field" for="dch-clerk-key">Clerk publishable key</label><input class="dch-input" id="dch-clerk-key" autocomplete="off" placeholder="pk_test_… or pk_live_…"><label class="dch-field" for="dch-supabase-url">Supabase project URL</label><input class="dch-input" id="dch-supabase-url" autocomplete="url"><label class="dch-field" for="dch-supabase-key">Supabase publishable key</label><input class="dch-input" id="dch-supabase-key" autocomplete="off" placeholder="sb_publishable_… or anon public key"><button class="dch-primary dch-setup-submit" id="dch-connect">Save and continue</button><div class="dch-error" id="dch-error"></div><div class="dch-note">These are public browser keys. Never enter a Clerk secret key or Supabase secret/service-role key. Values are saved only in this browser.</div></div></section>';
  $('#dch-clerk-key',b).value=config.clerkKey||'';
  $('#dch-supabase-url',b).value=config.supabaseUrl||DSMHUB_CHAT_DEFAULT_URL;
  $('#dch-supabase-key',b).value=config.supabaseKey||'';
  $('#dch-error',b).textContent=problem;
  $('#dch-connect',b).onclick=async()=>{
   const clerkKey=$('#dch-clerk-key',b).value.trim(),supabaseUrl=$('#dch-supabase-url',b).value.trim(),supabaseKey=$('#dch-supabase-key',b).value.trim(),err=$('#dch-error',b);
   if(!/^pk_(test|live)_/.test(clerkKey)){err.textContent='Use the Clerk publishable key from your Clerk dashboard.';return}
   if(!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.supabase\.co\/?$/i.test(supabaseUrl)){err.textContent='Enter the Supabase project URL.';return}
   if(!/^(sb_publishable_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.)/.test(supabaseKey)){err.textContent='Use the Supabase publishable/anon key, never a secret key.';return}
   config={clerkKey,supabaseUrl:supabaseUrl.replace(/\/$/,''),supabaseKey};chatSaveConfig(config);err.textContent='Connecting…';await connect()
  }
 };
 const showAuth=(problem='')=>{
  if(!b.isConnected)return;
  channelRequest++;const previous=subscription;subscription=null;if(previous&&db)db.removeChannel(previous).catch(()=>{})
  renderedUserId='';
  b.innerHTML='<section class="dch-gate"><div class="dch-card"><div class="dch-brand"><span class="dch-brand-mark">D</span><span>DSMHub Community</span></div><h2>Sign in to chat</h2><p>Use your DSMHub username account to join the community.</p><div class="dch-auth" id="dch-auth"></div><div class="dch-error" id="dch-error"></div><div class="dch-note">New here? Use the create-account link in the sign-in box. DSMHub accounts use usernames.</div></div></section>';
  $('#dch-error',b).textContent=problem;
  try{clerk.mountSignIn($('#dch-auth',b),{withSignUp:true,signInFallbackRedirectUrl:location.href,signUpFallbackRedirectUrl:location.href})}catch(e){$('#dch-error',b).textContent='Could not show the sign-in form: '+e.message}
 };
 async function connect(){
  if(busy||!b.isConnected)return;busy=true;
  try{
   if(!config.clerkKey||!config.supabaseKey||!config.supabaseUrl){showSetup();return}
   const domain=atob(config.clerkKey.split('_')[2]).replace(/\$$/,'');
   if(!/^[a-z0-9.-]+$/i.test(domain))throw new Error('The Clerk publishable key does not contain a valid Clerk domain.');
   if(!window.supabase||!window.supabase.createClient)await chatLoadScript('supabase','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js');
   if(!window.supabase||!window.supabase.createClient)throw new Error('The Supabase client did not load.');
   if(!window.Clerk){
    await chatLoadScript('clerk-ui','https://'+domain+'/npm/@clerk/ui@1/dist/ui.browser.js');
    await chatLoadScript('clerk-sdk','https://'+domain+'/npm/@clerk/clerk-js@6/dist/clerk.browser.js',config.clerkKey)
   }
   clerk=window.Clerk;await clerk.load({ui:{ClerkUI:window.__internal_ClerkUICtor}});
   db=window.supabase.createClient(config.supabaseUrl,config.supabaseKey,{auth:{persistSession:false,autoRefreshToken:false,detectSessionInUrl:false},accessToken:async()=>clerk&&clerk.session?await clerk.session.getToken():null});
   authListener=()=>{if(!b.isConnected){try{clerk.removeListener(authListener)}catch(e){}return}if(clerk.user)enterWorkspace();else showAuth()};
   clerk.addListener(authListener);
   if(clerk.user)await enterWorkspace();else showAuth()
  }catch(e){showSetup(e.message||'Could not connect to chat. Check the keys and try again.')}
  finally{busy=false}
 }
 async function enterWorkspace(){
  if(!b.isConnected||!clerk||!clerk.user)return;
  const user=clerk.user;
   if(renderedUserId===user.id&&$('.dch-app',b))return;
   if(enteringUserId===user.id)return;

   try{
  const username=String(user.username||'').trim();
