   const found=await db.from('dsmhub_profiles').select('username').eq('user_id',user.id).maybeSingle();
   if(found.error)throw found.error;
   if(found.data)profileName=found.data.username;
   else{const added=await db.from('dsmhub_profiles').insert({user_id:user.id,username}).select('username').single();if(added.error)throw added.error;profileName=added.data.username}
   }catch(e){showAuth('Could not prepare your chat profile: '+(e.message||'Check the Supabase profile table.'));return}
   await loadPermissions();
   await loadStructure(false);
  renderedUserId=user.id;
   b.innerHTML='<div class="dch dch-app"><aside class="dch-channels"><div class="dch-head"><span>DSMHub Community</span></div><div class="dch-channel-title"><span>CHANNELS</span><button class="dch-add-category" id="dch-add-category" title="Add category" aria-label="Add category" hidden>+</button></div><div class="dch-channel-list" id="dch-channel-list"></div><div class="dch-admin-note" id="dch-admin-note" hidden>Owner tools need the chat database update applied in Supabase.</div><div class="dch-server-info"><strong>DSMHub</strong>Community chat</div></aside><main class="dch-main"><header class="dch-top"><span class="dch-hash">#</span><strong id="dch-channel-title">general</strong><span class="dch-topic" id="dch-topic"></span><span class="dch-top-spacer"></span><span class="dch-connection" id="dch-status">Connecting…</span><span class="dch-user" id="dch-user"></span><span class="dch-role-badge" id="dch-current-role"></span><button class="dch-small-btn" id="dch-signout">Sign out</button></header><div class="dch-messages" id="dch-messages"></div><div class="dch-composer-wrap"><div class="dch-file-queue" id="dch-file-queue"></div><div class="dch-file-error" id="dch-file-error"></div><form class="dch-compose" id="dch-compose"><button class="dch-file-picker" id="dch-file-picker" type="button" title="Attach files" aria-label="Attach files">＋</button><input id="dch-files" type="file" multiple hidden><textarea id="dch-message" rows="1" maxlength="1500" placeholder="Message #general"></textarea><button class="dch-send" title="Send message" aria-label="Send message">➤</button></form><div class="dch-compose-help">Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · attach up to 3 files (15 MB each)</div></div></main><aside class="dch-members"><h3>COMMUNITY MEMBERS</h3><div id="dch-member-list"></div></aside></div>';
  $('#dch-user',b).textContent=profileName;
   $('#dch-current-role',b).textContent=currentRole==='owner'?'OWNER':currentRole==='moderator'?'MOD':'MEMBER';
   $('#dch-current-role',b).classList.toggle('owner',currentRole==='owner');
   $('#dch-add-category',b).hidden=currentRole!=='owner';
   $('#dch-admin-note',b).hidden=roleMap.__setup!==true;
   $('#dch-file-picker',b).disabled=roleMap.__setup===true;
   if(roleMap.__setup===true)$('#dch-file-picker',b).title='Apply the chat update in Supabase to enable file uploads';
  $('#dch-signout',b).onclick=async()=>{await clerk.signOut();renderedUserId='';showAuth()};
   $('#dch-add-category',b).onclick=addCategory;
   renderChannels();
   $('#dch-file-picker',b).onclick=()=>$('#dch-files',b).click();
   $('#dch-files',b).onchange=e=>{queueFiles([...e.target.files||[]]);e.target.value=''};
  $('#dch-compose',b).onsubmit=async e=>{
   e.preventDefault();const input=$('#dch-message',b),body=input.value.trim();
    if((!body&&!pendingFiles.length)||body.length>1500)return;
    const send=$('.dch-send',b),picker=$('#dch-file-picker',b);input.disabled=true;send.disabled=true;picker.disabled=true;
    try{
     const attachments=await uploadPendingFiles(user.id);
     const result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_messages').insert({channel:activeChannel,user_id:user.id,username:profileName,body,attachments});
     if(result.error){if(attachments.length)await db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').remove(attachments.map(x=>x.path)).catch(()=>{});throw result.error}
     input.value='';pendingFiles=[];renderFileQueue();$('#dch-file-error',b).textContent='';$('#dch-status',b).textContent='Connected';input.focus()
    }catch(error){$('#dch-status',b).textContent='Message failed';$('#dch-file-error',b).textContent=error.message||'Could not send this message.'}
    finally{input.disabled=false;send.disabled=false;picker.disabled=false}
  };
  $('#dch-message',b).onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();$('#dch-compose',b).requestSubmit()}};
  await selectChannel(activeChannel)
 
   }finally{if(enteringUserId===user.id)enteringUserId=''}}
 async function selectChannel(id){
  const request=++channelRequest;
  const channel=channels.find(x=>x.id===id)||channels[0];if(!channel)return;activeChannel=channel.id;
  const q=s=>b.querySelector(s);
  if(!q('.dch-app'))return;
  q('#dch-channel-title').textContent=channel.name;q('#dch-topic').textContent=channel.topic;q('#dch-message').placeholder='Message #'+channel.name;
  b.querySelectorAll('.dch-channel').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.channel===channel.id));
  const previous=subscription;subscription=null;
  if(previous&&db)await db.removeChannel(previous).catch(()=>{});
  if(request!==channelRequest||!q('.dch-app'))return;
  const box=q('#dch-messages');box.innerHTML='';
  const welcome=document.createElement('div');welcome.className='dch-welcome';
  const bubble=document.createElement('div');bubble.className='dch-hash';bubble.textContent='#';
  const heading=document.createElement('h2');heading.textContent='Welcome to #'+channel.name;
  const detail=document.createElement('p');detail.textContent='This is the start of the #'+channel.name+' channel.';
  welcome.append(bubble,heading,detail);box.append(welcome);q('#dch-status').textContent='Loading…';
  let result;
  try{result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_messages').select('id,channel,user_id,username,body,attachments,created_at').eq('channel',channel.id).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(100)}catch(error){result={data:[],error}}
  if(result.error)try{result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_messages').select('id,channel,user_id,username,body,created_at').eq('channel',channel.id).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(100);(result.data||[]).forEach(x=>x.attachments=[])}catch(error){result={data:[],error}}
  if(request!==channelRequest||!q('.dch-app'))return;
  if(result.error){q('#dch-status').textContent='Chat unavailable';const err=document.createElement('div');err.className='dch-empty';err.textContent=result.error.message||'Could not load messages.';box.append(err);return}
  for(const message of result.data||[])appendMessage(message);
  try{
   let next=db.channel('dsmhub-'+channel.id+'-'+(++channelSequence))
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'INSERT',schema:'public',table:'dsmhub_chat_messages',filter:'channel=eq.'+channel.id},payload=>appendMessage(payload.new));
   if(roleMap.__setup!==true)next=next
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'DELETE',schema:'public',table:'dsmhub_chat_messages',filter:'channel=eq.'+channel.id},payload=>removeMessageRow(payload.old&&payload.old.id))
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'dsmhub_chat_categories'},()=>loadStructure(true))
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'dsmhub_chat_channels'},()=>loadStructure(true))
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'dsmhub_chat_roles'},()=>loadPermissions().then(loadMembers));
   subscription=next;
   next.subscribe((status,error)=>{if(request!==channelRequest)return;const state=q('#dch-status');if(!state)return;if(status==='SUBSCRIBED')state.textContent='Connected';else if(status==='CHANNEL_ERROR'||status==='TIMED_OUT'){state.textContent='Live updates unavailable';if(error)console.warn('DSMHub chat realtime subscription:',error)}else if(status==='CLOSED')state.textContent='Disconnected';else state.textContent='Connecting…'});
  }catch(error){q('#dch-status').textContent='Live updates unavailable';console.warn('DSMHub chat realtime subscription:',error)}
  loadMembers()
 }
 function renderChannels(){
  const list=$('#dch-channel-list',b);if(!list)return;list.replaceChildren();
  for(const category of [...categories].sort((a,b)=>a.position-b.position||a.name.localeCompare(b.name))){
   const section=document.createElement('section');section.className='dch-category';
   const head=document.createElement('div');head.className='dch-category-head';const title=document.createElement('span');title.textContent=category.name;
   head.append(title);
   if(currentRole==='owner'){const add=document.createElement('button');add.type='button';add.className='dch-category-add';add.textContent='+';add.title='Add text channel';add.setAttribute('aria-label','Add text channel to '+category.name);add.onclick=()=>addChannel(category.id);head.append(add)}
   section.append(head);
   for(const channel of channels.filter(x=>x.category_id===category.id).sort((a,b)=>a.position-b.position||a.name.localeCompare(b.name))){const button=mk('<span class="dch-hash">#</span><span>'+esc(channel.name)+'</span>','button','dch-channel');button.dataset.channel=channel.id;button.onclick=()=>selectChannel(channel.id);button.classList.toggle('active',activeChannel===channel.id);section.append(button)}
   list.append(section)
  }
 }
 async function loadStructure(refresh=true){
  if(!db)return;
  let categoryResult,channelResult;try{[categoryResult,channelResult]=await Promise.all([db.from('dsmhub_chat_categories').select('id,name,position').order('position'),db.from('dsmhub_chat_channels').select('id,name,topic,category_id,position').order('position')])}catch(error){categories=defaultCategories.map(x=>({...x}));channels=defaultChannels.map(x=>({...x}));if(refresh)renderChannels();return}
  if(categoryResult.error||channelResult.error){categories=defaultCategories.map(x=>({...x}));channels=defaultChannels.map(x=>({...x}));if(refresh)renderChannels();return}
  categories=categoryResult.data&&categoryResult.data.length?categoryResult.data:defaultCategories.map(x=>({...x}));
  channels=channelResult.data&&channelResult.data.length?channelResult.data:defaultChannels.map(x=>({...x}));
  if(refresh){renderChannels();if(!channels.some(x=>x.id===activeChannel)&&channels.length)selectChannel(channels[0].id)}
 }
 async function loadPermissions(){
  let result;try{result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_roles').select('user_id,role')}catch(error){result={error}}
  if(result.error){roleMap={__setup:true};currentRole='member'}
  else{roleMap=Object.fromEntries((result.data||[]).map(x=>[x.user_id,x.role]));currentRole=roleMap[clerk.user.id]||'member'}
  const badge=$('#dch-current-role',b);if(badge){badge.textContent=currentRole==='owner'?'OWNER':currentRole==='moderator'?'MOD':'MEMBER';badge.classList.toggle('owner',currentRole==='owner')}
  const add=$('#dch-add-category',b);if(add)add.hidden=currentRole!=='owner';
  const note=$('#dch-admin-note',b);if(note)note.hidden=roleMap.__setup!==true;
  const picker=$('#dch-file-picker',b);if(picker){picker.disabled=roleMap.__setup===true;if(roleMap.__setup===true)picker.title='Apply the chat update in Supabase to enable file uploads'}
  renderChannels()
 }
 async function addCategory(){
  if(currentRole!=='owner')return;
  const name=prompt('Category name');if(!name||!name.trim())return;
  const id=slug(name);if(!id){alert('Use letters or numbers in the category name.');return}
  const result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_categories').insert({id,name:name.trim().slice(0,40),position:categories.length});
  if(result.error){alert('Could not add category: '+result.error.message);return}await loadStructure(true)
 }
 async function addChannel(categoryId){
  if(currentRole!=='owner')return;
  const name=prompt('Text channel name');if(!name||!name.trim())return;
  const id=slug(name);if(!id){alert('Use letters or numbers in the channel name.');return}
  const topic=(prompt('Channel description (optional)')||'').trim().slice(0,120),position=channels.filter(x=>x.category_id===categoryId).length;
  const result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_channels').insert({id,name:name.trim().replace(/^#+/,'').slice(0,40),topic,category_id:categoryId,position});
  if(result.error){alert('Could not add channel: '+result.error.message);return}await loadStructure(true)
 }
 function slug(value){return String(value||'').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^#+/,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').slice(0,40)}
 function queueFiles(files){
  const error=$('#dch-file-error',b);error.textContent='';
  for(const file of files){if(pendingFiles.length>=3){error.textContent='Attach up to 3 files to one message.';break}if(file.size>15*1024*1024){error.textContent=file.name+' is over the 15 MB file limit.';continue}pendingFiles.push(file)}
  renderFileQueue()
 }
 function renderFileQueue(){
  const queue=$('#dch-file-queue',b);if(!queue)return;queue.replaceChildren();
  pendingFiles.forEach((file,index)=>{const chip=document.createElement('div');chip.className='dch-file-chip';const name=document.createElement('span');name.textContent=file.name+' · '+(file.size<1024*1024?Math.ceil(file.size/1024)+' KB':(file.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1)+' MB');const remove=document.createElement('button');remove.type='button';remove.textContent='×';remove.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+file.name);remove.onclick=()=>{pendingFiles.splice(index,1);renderFileQueue()};chip.append(name,remove);queue.append(chip)})
 }
 async function uploadPendingFiles(userId){
  const uploaded=[];
  for(let i=0;i<pendingFiles.length;i++){
   const file=pendingFiles[i];$('#dch-status',b).textContent='Uploading '+(i+1)+' of '+pendingFiles.length+'…';
   const safeName=file.name.replace(/[\\/\u0000-\u001f]/g,'_').slice(0,120)||'file';const path=userId+'/'+crypto.randomUUID()+'-'+safeName;
   const result=await db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').upload(path,file,{cacheControl:'3600',upsert:false,contentType:file.type||'application/octet-stream'});
   if(result.error){if(uploaded.length)await db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').remove(uploaded.map(x=>x.path)).catch(()=>{});throw result.error}
   uploaded.push({path,name:file.name.slice(0,180),type:file.type||'application/octet-stream',size:file.size})
  }
  return uploaded
 }
 function removeMessageRow(id){if(!id)return;const box=$('#dch-messages',b);const row=box&&[...box.querySelectorAll('.dch-message')].find(x=>x.dataset.messageId===String(id));if(row)row.remove()}
 async function deleteMessage(message){
  if(roleMap.__setup===true||!(message.user_id===clerk.user.id||currentRole==='owner'||currentRole==='moderator'))return;
  if(!confirm('Delete this message?'))return;
  const result=await db.from('dsmhub_chat_messages').delete().eq('id',message.id).select('id');
  if(result.error){alert('Could not delete this message: '+result.error.message);return}
  removeMessageRow(message.id);
  const attachments=Array.isArray(message.attachments)?message.attachments:[];
  if(attachments.length)await db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments').remove(attachments.map(x=>x.path)).catch(()=>{})
 }
 async function setModerator(member){
  if(currentRole!=='owner'||member.user_id===clerk.user.id)return;
  const isMod=roleMap[member.user_id]==='moderator';
  const result=isMod?await db.from('dsmhub_chat_roles').delete().eq('user_id',member.user_id).eq('role','moderator'):await db.from('dsmhub_chat_roles').upsert({user_id:member.user_id,role:'moderator'},{onConflict:'user_id'});
  if(result.error){alert('Could not update moderator role: '+result.error.message);return}
  await loadPermissions();await loadMembers()
 }
 async function appendAttachmentList(message,container){
  const attachments=Array.isArray(message.attachments)?message.attachments:[];if(!attachments.length)return;
  const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='dch-attachments';container.append(wrap);
  for(const attachment of attachments){if(!attachment||typeof attachment.path!=='string')continue;
   const storage=db.storage.from('dsmhub-chat-attachments'),isImage=/^image\/(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|svg\+xml)$/i.test(attachment.type||'');
   const preview=isImage?await storage.createSignedUrl(attachment.path,3600):null;
   const download=await storage.createSignedUrl(attachment.path,3600,{download:true});
   if(download.error){const unavailable=document.createElement('span');unavailable.className='dch-file-error';unavailable.textContent='Attachment unavailable: '+(attachment.name||'file');wrap.append(unavailable);continue}
   const link=document.createElement('a');link.className='dch-attachment';link.href=download.data.signedUrl;link.target='_blank';link.rel='noopener noreferrer';link.textContent='↓ '+(attachment.name||'Download file');wrap.append(link);
   if(isImage&&preview&&!preview.error){const imageLink=document.createElement('a');imageLink.href=preview.data.signedUrl;imageLink.target='_blank';imageLink.rel='noopener noreferrer';const image=document.createElement('img');image.className='dch-attachment-preview';image.src=preview.data.signedUrl;image.alt=attachment.name||'Image attachment';image.loading='lazy';imageLink.append(image);wrap.insertBefore(imageLink,link)}
  }
 }
 function appendMessage(message){
  const box=$('#dch-messages',b);if(!box||!message)return;
  if([...box.querySelectorAll('.dch-message')].some(x=>x.dataset.messageId===String(message.id)))return;
  const row=document.createElement('article');row.className='dch-message';row.dataset.messageId=message.id;
  const avatar=document.createElement('div');avatar.className='dch-avatar';avatar.textContent=String(message.username||'?').slice(0,1).toUpperCase();
  const content=document.createElement('div');content.className='dch-msg-content';const head=document.createElement('div');head.className='dch-msg-head';
  const name=document.createElement('strong');name.textContent=message.username||'Unknown';const time=document.createElement('time');const stamp=new Date(message.created_at);time.textContent=Number.isNaN(stamp.getTime())?'':stamp.toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'});
  const body=document.createElement('div');body.className='dch-msg-body';body.textContent=message.body||'';
  head.append(name,time);
  if(roleMap.__setup!==true&&(message.user_id===clerk.user.id||currentRole==='owner'||currentRole==='moderator')){const tools=document.createElement('div');tools.className='dch-message-tools';const remove=document.createElement('button');remove.type='button';remove.className='dch-message-delete';remove.textContent='Delete';remove.onclick=()=>deleteMessage(message);tools.append(remove);head.append(tools)}
  content.append(head,body);row.append(avatar,content);box.append(row);appendAttachmentList(message,content).then(()=>{box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight}).catch(error=>console.warn('Chat attachment preview:',error));box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight
 }
 async function loadMembers(){
  const list=$('#dch-member-list',b);if(!list)return;list.innerHTML='';
  const {data,error}=await db.from('dsmhub_profiles').select('user_id,username').order('username').limit(100);
  if(error){list.textContent='Members are unavailable.';return}
  for(const member of data||[]){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='dch-member';const avatar=document.createElement('span');avatar.className='dch-avatar';avatar.textContent=String(member.username||'?').slice(0,1).toUpperCase();const name=document.createElement('span');name.className='dch-member-name';name.textContent=member.username;row.append(avatar,name);const role=roleMap[member.user_id];if(role==='owner'||role==='moderator'){const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='dch-role-badge'+(role==='owner'?' owner':'');badge.textContent=role==='owner'?'OWNER':'MOD';row.append(badge)}if(currentRole==='owner'&&member.user_id!==clerk.user.id){const tools=document.createElement('span');tools.className='dch-member-tools';const manage=document.createElement('button');manage.type='button';manage.className='dch-manage-member';manage.textContent=role==='moderator'?'Remove mod':'Make mod';manage.onclick=()=>setModerator(member);tools.append(manage);row.append(tools)}list.append(row)}
 }
 if(config.clerkKey&&config.supabaseKey&&config.supabaseUrl)connect();else showSetup()
}

// ---- games (encrypted) ----
// Files in games/ are AES-GCM encrypted with your code, so nobody can read the game source on GitHub without it.
// Make them with encrypt.html, then upload the .enc files and index.json to the games/ folder.
const KDF=1000;
// Games open with no code. This key is baked in (encrypt.html has the same one). If you change it, re-encrypt your games.
const GAMES_KEY='3d55bf4b0663c90ef947553c929df7be';
const gcode=GAMES_KEY;
const gp=n=>n.includes('/')?n:'games/'+n,isEnc=f=>/\.enc$/i.test(f);
async function gdec(code,buf){const u=new Uint8Array(buf),k0=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',new TextEncoder().encode(code),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']),key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:u.slice(0,16),iterations:KDF,hash:'SHA-256'},k0,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:u.slice(16,28)},key,u.slice(28))))}
async function glist(){const r=await fetch('games/index.json',{cache:'no-cache'});return r.ok?await r.json():[]}
function gamesApp(b){
 b.innerHTML='<div class="gm"><div class="gg"><div class="gs"><input type="search" placeholder="Search games" aria-label="Search games"></div><div class="gr">Loading…</div></div></div>';
 const gr=$('.gr',b),q=$('.gs input',b);let tabs=[];
 const GP='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="34" height="34" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">'+IC.games[2]+'</svg>';
 async function loadAll(){const src=(await glist().catch(()=>[])).map(f=>({f:gp(f)}));
  tabs=await Promise.all(src.map(async s=>{const nm=s.f.split('/').pop();try{if(isEnc(s.f)){const r=await fetch(s.f);if(!r.ok)throw 0;const o=await gdec(gcode,await r.arrayBuffer());return {...s,n:o.n||nm,h:o.h,t:o.t}}return {...s,n:nm}}catch(e){return {...s,n:nm,bad:1}}}));
  tabs.sort((x,y)=>x.n.localeCompare(y.n))}
 function playGame(t){const gid=(t.f.split('/').pop()||t.n).replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');openApp('games',{id:'games',fs:true,n:t.n,icon:'games',w:860,h:600,r:(body,win)=>{const fr=document.createElement('iframe');fr.title=t.n;fr.allow='fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad; pointer-lock';fr.setAttribute('allowfullscreen','');fr.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#fff';body.append(fr);if(t.h!=null){attachSaveSync(fr,gid,t.h).then(stop=>{win.onclose=stop})}else fr.src=t.f}})}
 function renderGrid(){gr.innerHTML='';const k=q.value.trim().toLowerCase(),list=tabs.filter(t=>t.n.toLowerCase().includes(k));
  if(!list.length){gr.append(mk(tabs.length?'No games match your search.':'No games yet. Encrypt them with encrypt.html, upload them to the games folder, and list them in games/index.json.','p','gn'));return}
  list.forEach(t=>{const ok=t.t&&!t.bad,el=mk(null,'button','tile'+(ok?'':' ph')+(t.bad?' bad':''));el.title=t.bad?'Could not load this game. Check the path and the code.':t.n;
   if(ok){const im=document.createElement('img');im.alt='';im.src=t.t;el.append(im)}else el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',GP);
   el.append(mk(esc(t.n),'span'));el.onclick=()=>{if(!t.bad)playGame(t)};gr.append(el)})}
 q.oninput=renderGrid;loadAll().then(renderGrid)}
// lock screen
const lock=$('#lock');
function lockTick(){const d=new Date();$('#lt').textContent=d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});$('#ld').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'long',month:'long',day:'numeric'})}
lockTick();setInterval(lockTick,1000);
function unlock(){lock.classList.add('gone')}
function relock(){menu(false);wins.filter(o=>o.a.id==='games').forEach(o=>$('.x',o.w).click());lock.classList.remove('gone')}
lock.onclick=unlock;
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!lock.classList.contains('gone')){e.preventDefault();unlock()}});
openApp('notes');
</script>
</body>
</html>
